indexText: Installation for sign companies and contractors, and repair, maintenance and refresh for business owners across Central Florida.

services.name: Channel Letter Installation
services.short: Raceway and flush-mount channel letters for storefronts and buildings.
services.intro: Raceway-mounted and flush-mount channel letters installed level, sealed and wired to code, on stucco, EIFS, block, metal and brick walls.
includes: Pattern layout and wall penetration sealing
Electrical connection to an existing circuit

services.name: Pylon & Pole Sign Installation
services.short: Single and multi-tenant pylon and pole signs, faces and cabinets.
services.intro: New pylon and pole sign installation, cabinet replacement and tenant face changes for shopping centers, dealerships, gas stations and plazas.
includes: New pylon and pole sign installation
services.audience: Sign companies, property managers and businesses

services.name: Monument Sign Installation
services.short: Monument and entrance signs for plazas, offices and communities.
services.intro: Monument and entrance sign installation for offices, plazas, churches, schools and residential communities, including panel and face replacements.

services.name: Contour Lightbox Installation
services.short: Contour lightboxes, blade signs and interior signage.
services.intro: Contour lightbox, cabinet and blade sign installation for storefronts, plus lobby and interior signage.
includes: Electrical connection to an existing circuit

services.name: Sign Removal & Rebranding
services.short: Old sign removal, patch and paint, and the new sign in one visit.
services.intro: Safe removal of old signage, wall patch and paint, and installation of the new brand — one crew, one visit, ideal for rebrand rollouts.
includes: Removal and disposal of old signs

services.name: Sign Repair
services.short: Repair for channel letters, cabinets, pylon and pole signs.
services.intro: Business sign repair for channel letters, cabinets, pylon, pole and monument signs, including storm damage.
includes: Photo report of the work done

services.name: LED & Sign Lighting Repair
services.short: Sign lights out? LED repair, power supplies and neon-to-LED.
services.intro: Sign lights not working? We find the problem and fix it: LED modules, power supplies, timers and photocells, plus LED upgrades and neon-to-LED conversion.
includes: LED module and power supply replacement

services.name: Sign Maintenance & Restoration
services.short: Cleaning, repainting and refresh so your sign looks new.
services.intro: Florida sun and rain wear signs down. We clean faces and letters, repaint cabinets and structures, treat rust and keep every sign bright with scheduled maintenance.
services.audience: Business owners, franchises and property managers

services.name: Sign Surveys & Permits
services.short: Site surveys, measurements and permit coordination.
services.intro: Site surveys with photos and measurements of wall and electrical conditions, and permit coordination with local cities and counties before install day.
includes: Site survey with photos and measurements
